sn12.45:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Ñatika in the Brick Hall.
sn12.45:1.3: Then, while the Blessed One was alone in seclusion, he uttered this Dhamma exposition:
sn12.45:2.1: “In dependence on the eye and forms, eye-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.45:2.2: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.45:2.5: Such is the origin of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.45:3.1: “In dependence on the ear and sounds …
sn12.45:3.5: In dependence on the mind and mental phenomena, mind-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.45:3.6: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.45:3.9: Such is the origin of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.45:4.1: “In dependence on the eye and forms, eye-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.45:4.2: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.45:4.4: But with the remainderless fading away and cessation of that same craving comes cessation of clinging;
sn12.45:4.5: with the cessation of clinging, cessation of existence….
sn12.45:4.6: Such is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.45:5.1: “In dependence on the ear and sounds …
sn12.45:5.2: In dependence on the mind and mental phenomena, mind-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.45:5.3: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.45:5.5: But with the remainderless fading away and cessation of that same craving comes cessation of clinging;
sn12.45:5.6: with the cessation of clinging, cessation of existence….
sn12.45:5.7: Such is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering.”
sn12.45:6.1: Now on that occasion a certain bhikkhu was standing listening in on the Blessed One.
sn12.45:6.2: The Blessed One saw him standing there listening in and said to him:
sn12.45:6.4: “Did you hear that Dhamma exposition, bhikkhu?”
sn12.45:6.9: That Dhamma exposition is beneficial and relevant to the fundamentals of the holy life.”
